summary: A work item went back to the queue to be claimed again: its attempt failed in a way worth another attempt, a restart found its attempt never started, or the question it was waiting on ended, because a person approved it or because an edit of the work's input withdrew it. The `approval_approved` or `approval_superseded` line written in the same save tells which, and is the record of a person's decision; the line's `reason` is free text and decides nothing.

key.description: The attempt that ended, by its id; `status` where the question the work was waiting on ended: a person approved it, or an edit of the work's input withdrew it. The `approval_approved` or `approval_superseded` line written in the same save tells which.

new.description: An attempt that failed and is worth another one.

code.description: The code the attempt failed with.

retry_after.description: The moment before which the item is not claimed again; null where no delay is set.

new.description: An attempt claimed before a restart and never started: nobody's fault, and not counted.
